clothing: a photograph of a fashion garment such as a shirt, jacket, dress or trousers
a photo of clothing or apparel for sale, including a garment worn by a person

a picture of footwear worn on feet or displayed as a fashion product

a flat graphic showing a company logo, brand symbol or lettering with no physical product
documents: a scan of a document, printed page, handwritten letter or form
a flat image of a map, chart, poster or non-fashion graphic illustration
technical-diagrams: a technical schematic with lines, symbols or engineering annotations
a standalone electrical symbol, circuit diagram or technical drawing
electronics: a photograph of an electronic device such as a computer, circuit board or telephone
a product photo of a gadget, electronic component, connector or appliance
household: a photograph of a household object such as furniture, a lamp, a mug or a cushion

vehicles: a photograph of a vehicle such as a car, truck, train or boat
a real-world photo of a transport vehicle in traffic, a garage or an exhibition
buildings: a photograph of a building, architecture or an architectural landmark
a photo of a building exterior, a room interior or an urban streetscape
food: a photograph of a meal, fruit, vegetables, dessert or other food

landscapes: a photograph of a natural landscape such as mountains, a forest or a waterfall
